text: The Nominating Panel – Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal must select candidates to interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal. Following the interviews, the Nominating Panel will recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.

The Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: Candidate DDR1-174 Candidate DDR1-216 Candidate DDR1-217 Candidate DDR1-218 Candidate DDR1-227 Candidate DDR1-230 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (January 14, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.
